project.name: Evidence Packet Workbench
project.summary: Manual-first email-delivery incident workbench for agencies/MSPs that turns headers, NDRs, ESP exports, seed observations, and notes into bounded hypotheses and redacted support packets.
project.target_customer: Agencies/MSPs and deliverability consultants handling repeated Gmail/Microsoft 365 incidents for clients.
project.business_model: B2B SaaS subscription by agency workspace/client/domain/active incident, with optional paid expert review.

main_reasons: Repeated public pain signals and adjacent paid tools support problem severity.
The exact recurring SaaS willingness to pay for evidence packets is unproven.
MVP is feasible but requires privacy-safe artifact handling and trustworthy rule output.
The project can work as a niche SaaS/productized service if retention and CAC are validated.
critical_assumptions: Agencies/MSPs have multiple relevant incidents per quarter.
Packets save at least 30% of triage/escalation prep time.
Customers pay EUR 149-399/month and retain after the first incident.
Sensitive artifact intake is acceptable with redaction and retention controls.
next_actions: Run 10-20 concierge packet prototypes on historical cases.
Sell 3 paid pilots before full MVP build.
Build parser/rule fixture prototype only after paid pilot signal.
kill_criteria: Fewer than 3 of 10 qualified prospects agree to paid pilot.
Concierge packets save less than 30% time.
CAC cannot plausibly stay below EUR 1,500 at base ARPU.
